# dsh-sidebar-reader
English | 中文
Let your model read the **current session's** sidebar on demand: the active tab, official right-side
bar tabs, terminal screens, and browser page text.
Once installed, just tell the model "read my sidebar" or "show me my terminal" — the model triggers
a capture through the plugin's command channel and receives a snapshot within seconds.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Agent tool (auto-registered)
The plugin's host side registers a native agent tool **`sidebar_read`** with the DSH tool registry:
it appears in every new session's tool list automatically, and one **zero-argument call** returns th
e full snapshot — no HTTP, no configuration. The "prefer this over pwsh/web_fetch for terminal or pa
ge questions" preference is encoded in the tool description itself.
The HTTP endpoints below remain as a fallback channel.
## Features
| Channel | Source | Notes |
| Active tab | `sidebarRight.active()` | The active pane's active tab (id / kind / title / contentId

), plus `expanded` telling whether the column is showing |
| Right-sidebar tabs | `sidebarRight.open

Tabs` live snapshot | Every open tab of the current session (`tabId` / `kind` / `contentId`) |
| Ter
minal screens | `remote.terminal.attach` first snapshot frame | Full screen including scrollback; in

put control is released right after reading |
| Web page text | Sidebar browser webview `innerText`
| **Desktop (Electron) only**; strict mode, see below |
### Strict mode for web page text
The page is read only when **the active tab is a browser** *and* **the column is expanded**. Otherwi
se `page` is `null`.
Why: when a sidebar browser tab moves to the background, its webview stays in the DOM with zero widt
h, and the fallback picker would still return it — the model would receive a page the user is not lo
oking at. `null` is better than the wrong page.
## What you get
| What you are looking at | Readable | Notes |
| A page in the sidebar browser | ✅ title + URL + text | Must be the active browser tab, with the co

lumn expanded |
| A file / document tab | ⚠️ address only | You get its `contentId` (e.g. `dsh-resou

rce://file/...`); read the file by that path |
| A terminal | ✅ full screen | Includes scrollback (m

ax 40k chars per terminal) |
| Plain web build (browser access) | ❌ page text | No webview; tabs and
terminals still work |

Design disciplines:
1. **Scope** — everything is filtered to the session on screen before leaving the browser; other ses

sions are unreadable;
2. **Never throws** — each channel degrades independently; one failing channel
ll side effects live in `ctx.effect` and are cleaned up when the plugin is disabled.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
On the official DSH Desktop app, install from the app's own **Settings → Plugins** (or clone this re
po anywhere and point the plugin manager's local install at the folder).
## Requirements
- **DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2** (terminal capture uses `remote.terminal.attach`; on 0.2.0-rc.2 the plugin lo

ads and tabs work, but terminal capture errors out — that version still called it `follow`)
- **No b

etter-sidebar required** — official services only (`sidebarRight`, `remote.terminal`)
- Web page tex
t is desktop-only; the web build still gets the active tab, tabs and terminals
## Compatibility
| Host version | Loads | Active tab | Sidebar tabs | Terminals | Web page text |
enamed follow→attach) | desktop ✅ / web ❌ |
Verified: all four channels on 0.2.1-rc.5; install + composition + client module registration on 0.2
.1-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1 (`scripts/test-plugin.ps1`).
## Development & testing
Two Windows PowerShell scripts ship with the repo:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Two traps worth knowing:
- **Client changes require a page refresh**: the host swaps the bundle immediately (rev changes), bu
t a module already loaded in the page is not replaced — HMR graph sync only adds/removes entries, it

does not replace an existing one;
- **The `id` in `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` must equal the np
m package name** (including scope). DSH's client module system matches registrations by package name
; a mismatch fails silently — `sidebar_read` still answers, but every capture times out.
## Privacy & security

- Reads the current session only; other sessions' data never leaves the browser;
- Everything stays
on your machine: host routes sit on loopback HTTP (`/sidebar-reader/*`), no browser auth, nothing le
## Host routes (prefix `/sidebar-reader`)
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |

| `/health` | GET | Self-check: snapshot present? command pending? |
| `/latest` | GET | Model reads

the snapshot (404 when empty) |
| `/latest` | POST | Client submits a snapshot (replace-only-latest

` | GET | Client claims a command (consume-on-read) |
| `/command` | POST | Model issues a command |
## Changelog
- **1.0.1** — fixed the client module registration id not matching the package name (previously the
client never loaded on any host, surfacing as `capture timed out`); `tabs[].id` now carries the real
`tabId`; added `right.active` (the active tab) and `right.expanded`; web page text is now strict mo

de (`null` unless a browser tab is active and the column is expanded).
- **1.0.0** — first release.
